campos.textarea[name=\"message\"]: Hello / Bonjour, I am Vini Cavalcanti, Senior 3D Character Artist, 10+ years on stylized characters. On The Wingfeather Saga season 1 (Angel Studios) I modeled and hand-painted the characters, and at E-Line Media I take Endstar's hero characters from first sculpt to engine: ZBrush sculpt, retopology, UVs, baking, texturing, look development and grooming in Houdini. Portfolio: artstation.com/viniciuscavalcanti. This is a spontaneous application for your animation and new media work. Two honest points so nobody loses time: I live in Brazil and would relocate to Quebec, so I would need work-permit sponsorship; and I work in English and Portuguese, not in French. CV attached. Thank you for your time. Vini Cavalcanti, contact@vinicavalcanti.art
